text: The "undefined" cause is found: the filler filter in `Sessions.js` didn't know the word, so the pause-nudged turn posted it as a reply. `minion-undefined-guard` is building the fix with a test first. Still waiting on the interrupt build and the eyeballs, phantom "Thank you." and Whisper-search minions.

The Whisper search says the server already has speech detection on, and suggests two cheap flags to add. I'm waiting on the phantom-clips minion's data before briefing the one build. Still running: `minion-interrupt-build`, `minion-eyeballs-scope`, `minion-phantom-thanks` and `minion-undefined-guard`.

The phantom "Thank you." has two causes: a Whisper hallucination on a 1.4-second burst of room noise at 12:07, and the assistant's own read-aloud heard back through the mic at 12:48. `minion-phantom-gate` is building a send-side gate that drops a stock phrase only when the assistant was speaking or the clip was very short. Also running: `minion-interrupt-build`, `minion-undefined-guard` and `minion-eyeballs-scope`.

The eyeballs scoping is done and reported on the card: one small `ChatWatch` class on the shared headless browser, with throttled snapshots written to a log. I'll build it after the current fixes land. Still waiting on `minion-interrupt-build`, `minion-undefined-guard` and `minion-phantom-gate`.

The reviewer found no defect in the interrupt and plugin diffs. Its test failures came from running against the live site, which still serves the old `Recite.js`. I've asked it to re-run the tests against the worktree's own server and give a final merge yes or no. Still waiting on that and on `minion-phantom-gate`.

The phantom-gate build is done and committed on `worktree/qf-9`, along with the `undefined` guard, the two Whisper flags and the docs. `reviewer-qf9` is checking it, and `reviewer-qf1` is still re-running the interrupt tests. I'll merge both branches once each reviewer says yes.
That's the phantom-gate minion's closing log line, already covered. Waiting on `reviewer-qf1` and `reviewer-qf9`.

The merge was refused until the branch had a review, so I ran the review script. It said "fix" with seven findings, mostly small. The main one: the Whisper flags only take effect once whisper-server itself is restarted, and Servex doesn't do that. `minion-qf9-fixes` is fixing them now, and I'll re-run the review and merge after that. Still waiting on `reviewer-qf1` for the interrupt branch.

I've filed the owner's eight asks as tasks and sent two minions to investigate them. I'm now waiting on four things:
- `reviewer-qf1`, whose re-run decides the merge of the interrupt and plugin branch.
- `minion-qf9-fixes`, which is fixing the review findings on the phantom-gate branch.
- `minion-asks-236`, which is checking the placement, origin-record, one-list and jumping asks.
- `minion-asks-4-cost`, which is auditing the injected lines and the cost per sentence.

Nothing new there: I already have the ask 5/6 answers and sent them to the tab. Still waiting on the qf-9 whisper-flag fix and the two qf-1 fixes.

`qf-9` and `qf-1` are not merged yet. Both are fixed on their branches, but the merge gate is blocked by 13 open findings from the `qf-1` re-review.

- **`qf-9`:** the `whisper-detach` test failure was not the new whisper flags. Orphaned test `whisper-server` processes from earlier killed runs were starving each new run. The fix is committed (`992fe5899`) and the test now passes twice, with the live whisper untouched.
- **`qf-1`:** the reviewer's findings 1–6 are real, so I sent them back to the minion to fix, along with a few of the minor notes. They are a false "skipped" note on every cut-in, plugins that can attach twice, and three stale docs. The brief and task-folder files also need committing.
- **Order from here:** re-review `qf-1`, answer its findings, merge it, then merge `qf-9`. I set a 10-minute wake-up to pick that up.

The `qf-1` merge is still blocked: the second re-review came back with 4 must-fix findings and 4 notes, and a third fix round is running. I haven't merged `qf-1` or `qf-9` yet.

- **Round 3 fixes:**
  - The false "skipped" note when a cut lands during a turn-taking hold.
  - A missing `requirements.md` in the task folder.
  - A change to the shared mastermind role text that no owner ask covers (I'm reverting it).
  - A stale `settings-plugins.md` that duplicated plugin settings already built on `michael/dev`.
- **After that:** re-review `qf-1`, answer the findings, merge `qf-1`, then `qf-9`. I set a wake-up for about 9 minutes.
- **`mastermind-chat-settings`:** I told it the merge is about 15–20 minutes out and that it can stack its branch on `worktree/qf-1` now.
- **Stray `public/public/` tree:** most of it is already tracked in git history and not from this work, so I'm leaving it.
Already handled: that is the round-2 review I sent to the `qf-1` minion. I'm waiting on its round-3 fixes, and the wake-up will bring me back to re-review and merge.

`qf-1` is merged into `michael/dev` (`bc4147365`), and I told `mastermind-chat-settings` and `vscode-mastermind`. It adds the cut-in when you speak and the per-instance plugin rows in `core/Plugin`. `qf-9` is still not merged.

- **`qf-9` blocker:** `Servex/whisper-detach.test.mjs` passes on its own but fails inside the merge runner's full-suite run, where it leaves a stray test whisper-server behind.
- **Fix in progress:** the `qf-9` fixes minion is finding out why the merge runner differs. It will make the test kill only the whisper-server it started and count only its own, without touching the live whisper-server.
- **Next:** once that is committed I'll sync `qf-9` with `michael/dev` and merge it. The sync failed this time because of uncommitted log files in the worktree, so I'll commit those first. The wake-up is set for about 8 minutes.
- **After `qf-9`:** batching, the `from` field, tap-to-expand raw, and the move fix.

`qf-9` is merged into `michael/dev` (`840880254`) and all 115 covering tests passed. I killed the live whisper-server and restarted Servex so the new Sessions.js, brief and whisper flags take effect, and I'm now waiting for it to come back before checking the revived agents and briefing the next builds.
